source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-35

procedures.title: Panel replacement
steps: Squeeze excess plastic out of the cloth.
Lay the wetted backup plies on the underside of the panels, holding them with paper until the plastic gels if needed.
Mix another batch of resin and hardener thoroughly and add glass fiber cut in 1/2 inch lengths until it is putty-like, or use glass cloth instead.
Fill the V groove with the reinforced mix or saturated cloth, building up the surrounding area enough for finishing.
File or sand (#80-D paper) to the general panel contour.
Let the fill harden, then sand ready for paint.
notes: Figures 55 (typical body bonds), 56, 57 and 58 (plastic solder mixing, applying, finishing) are on this page.

procedures.title: Hard top care and storage
steps: Clean the painted outside of the hard top the same way as the rest of the body.
